Diamonds have intrinsic beauty that has fascinated humans for centuries.
words.trap: با extrinsic (بیرونی) متضاد است؛ intrinsic = درونی، extrinsic = بیرونی

words.coreMeaning: ریشه‌دار و دیرینه بودن عادت یا باور؛ اصلاح‌ناپذیر
definitions: Having a particular habit or interest that is long-established and unlikely to change
Deep-rooted and firmly established
examples: He was an inveterate liar who could not tell the truth.
She is an inveterate reader who finishes a book every week.
words.trap: با inveterate (دیرینه) و invertebrate (بی‌مهره) اشتباه نشود؛ معانی کاملاً متفاوتی دارند

words.coreMeaning: به راحتی عصبانی شدن؛ تندخو و زودرنج
definitions: Having or showing a tendency to be easily angered
Quick-tempered and irritable
examples: The irascible professor yelled at students who arrived late.
His irascible temperament made it difficult to work with him.
words.trap: با irritable (تحریک‌پذیر) تفاوت دارد؛ irascible شدیدتر و دائمی‌تر از irritable است

words.coreMeaning: سزاوار ستایش و تحسین؛ قابل تقدیر
definitions: Deserving praise and commendation
Worthy of approval and admiration
examples: Her laudable efforts to clean up the neighborhood inspired others.
The charity's laudable mission to feed the hungry gained widespread support.
words.trap: با laudatory (ستایش‌آمیز) تفاوت دارد؛ laudable یعنی سزاوار ستایش و laudatory یعنی حاوی ستایش

words.coreMeaning: بی‌حالی و کمبود انرژی؛ خواب‌آلود و کسل
definitions: Affected by lethargy; sluggish and apathetic
Lacking energy and enthusiasm; drowsy
examples: The hot weather made everyone feel lethargic and unmotivated.
After the big meal, he felt lethargic and couldn't concentrate.
words.trap: با Lethe (رودخانه فراموشی در اساطیر یونان) ارتباط ریشه‌ای دارد؛ lethargy یعنی فراموشی و بی‌حالی

words.coreMeaning: رفتار مقتدرانه و تحکم‌آمیز
definitions: Assuming power or authority without justification; arrogant.
Urgent; pressing.
examples: Her imperious manner intimidated the junior staff.
He spoke in an imperious tone that brooked no argument.
words.trap: با 'imperial' (امپراتوری) مرتبط ولی متفاوت است

words.coreMeaning: کم شدن شدت یا میزان چیزی
definitions: To become less intense or widespread
To reduce in amount, degree, or intensity
examples: The storm finally abated after three days of heavy rain.
His anger abated once he heard the full explanation.
words.trap: با abdicate (کناره‌گیری) اشتباه نگیرید. abate به معنای کاهش است نه ترک قدرت.

words.coreMeaning: مربوط به درک زیبایی و هنر
definitions: Concerned with beauty or the appreciation of beauty
Relating to the philosophy of beauty and taste
examples: The building has great aesthetic appeal.
Her aesthetic sensibilities influenced her choice of furniture.
words.trap: در انگلیسی بریتانیایی به صورت esthetic هم نوشته می‌شود اما aesthetic رایج‌تر است.

words.coreMeaning: آمادگی و سرعت مشتاقانه در انجام کار
definitions: Brisk and cheerful readiness
Promptness in response to a request or command
examples: She accepted the invitation with alacrity.
He responded to the challenge with great alacrity.
words.trap: alacrity همیشه بار مثبت دارد. با reluctance (بی‌میلی) که بار منفی دارد اشتباه نگیرید.

words.coreMeaning: چیزی که در زمان نادرست قرار گرفته است
definitions: Something that is placed in the wrong historical period
A thing belonging to a former age that is incongruous in the present
examples: The knight riding a bicycle is an anachronism.
Using a typewriter today seems like an anachronism.
words.trap: انیمیشن‌ها و فیلم‌های تاریخی گاهی عمدتاً anachronism دارند. این واژه بار منفی خفیفی دارد.

words.coreMeaning: احساس شدید ناخوشایند نسبت به کسی یا چیزی
definitions: A deep-seated feeling of dislike or aversion
Natural or basic aversion or opposition
examples: He felt a strong antipathy toward his rival.
There is a natural antipathy between cats and dogs.
words.trap: antipathy (نفرت) دقیقاً متضاد sympathy (همدلی) است. پیشوند anti- نشانه مخالفت است.

words.coreMeaning: پنهان و قابل فهم فقط برای عده‌ای خاص
definitions: Understood by very few; mysterious or secret
Known or understood by only a few people
examples: The professor lectured on arcane aspects of medieval philosophy.
The ritual involved arcane symbols and gestures.
words.trap: arcane فقط به معنای سخت نیست، بلکه به معنای پنهان و مخفی است. مترادف esoteric است.

words.coreMeaning: احساس شدید ناخوشایند یا بی‌میلی
definitions: A strong feeling of dislike or unwillingness
A settled dislike or opposition of mind
examples: He has a strong aversion to public speaking.
She felt an aversion to the idea of moving abroad.
words.trap: aversion به with نمی‌آید، همیشه to می‌گیرد: aversion to something.

words.coreMeaning: گزاره‌ای که بدون اثبات پذیرفته می‌شود
definitions: A statement or proposition that is regarded as being self-evidently true
A widely accepted rule or principle
examples: It is an axiom that practice makes perfect.
The axiom 'knowledge is power' has stood the test of time.
words.trap: axiom با theorem (قضیه) فرق دارد. axiom بدون اثبات پذیرفته می‌شود اما theorem نیاز به اثبات دارد.

words.coreMeaning: تحت فشار و محاصره قرار دادن
definitions: To put in a very difficult situation
To besiege or surround with hostile forces
examples: The beleaguered city finally surrendered after months of siege.
The beleaguered manager faced criticism from all sides.
words.trap: beleaguered به عنوان صفت بسیار رایج‌تر از فعل آن است.

words.coreMeaning: بی‌پروا و بی‌شرمانه عمل کردن
definitions: Bold and without shame
Made of or resembling brass in color or hardness
examples: It was a brazen attempt to cheat the system.
She made a brazen denial despite all the evidence.
words.trap: brazen به عنوان صفت بی‌شرمانه است، نه فقط شجاعانه. بار منفی دارد.

words.coreMeaning: به طور رسمی تسلیم شدن یا کوتاه آمدن
definitions: To surrender under agreed conditions
To cease resisting; to give in
examples: The army was forced to capitulate after running out of supplies.
She refused to capitulate to their demands.
words.trap: capitulate بیشتر به معنای تسلیم رسمی و با شرایط است، نه تسلیم ساده. مترادف surrender نیست دقیقاً.

words.coreMeaning: استدلال غلط که ظاهر درست دارد
definitions: A mistaken belief based on unsound argument
A flaw in reasoning that renders an argument invalid
examples: It is a common fallacy that goldfish have a three-second memory.
The argument contains several logical fallacies.
words.trap: fallacy (مغالطه) و fallibility (خطاپذیری) هم‌ریشه‌اند اما معنای متفاوتی دارند.

words.coreMeaning: عمیقاً درک کردن یا فهمیدن
definitions: To understand a difficult problem after much thought
To measure the depth of water
examples: I cannot fathom why she would do such a thing.
The bay was fathomed at twenty feet deep.
words.trap: fathom به عنوان اسم واحد اندازه‌گیری عمق (6 فوت) هم استفاده می‌شود.

words.coreMeaning: کلمات توهین‌آمیز و شدید
definitions: Insulting, abusive, or highly critical language
A violent verbal attack
examples: He hurled invective at his opponents.
The speech was filled with bitter invective.
words.trap: invective با invective (صفت) تفاوت دارد. به عنوان اسم بیشتر استفاده می‌شود.

words.coreMeaning: تمایل به طرح دعوا و شکایت
definitions: Tending or too ready to take legal action to settle disputes
Of or relating to legal proceedings
examples: We live in an increasingly litigious society.
His litigious nature cost him many friendships.
words.trap: litigious به معنای مرتبط با دعوا نیست، بلکه به معنای تمایل به شکایت کردن است.

words.coreMeaning: بلندمرتبه یا دارای آرمان‌های والا
definitions: Of imposing height; of a noble or exalted nature
Superior and condescending in manner
examples: She has lofty ambitions to change the world.
His lofty ideals inspired the entire generation.
words.trap: lofty می‌تواند مثبت (آرمان‌های والا) یا منفی (متکبرانه) باشد.

words.coreMeaning: عمداً قصد آسیب رساندن داشتن
definitions: Intending to do harm or cause suffering to others
Characterized by malice; deliberately harmful
examples: The malicious rumor destroyed his reputation.
She was the victim of a malicious attack online.
words.trap: malicious (شرورانه) و malignant (بدخیم) هم‌ریشه‌اند اما در context متفاوت استفاده می‌شوند.

words.coreMeaning: احساس غم عمیق و مداوم
definitions: A deep, persistent feeling of sadness or sorrow
A pensive, gloomy state of mind
examples: A sense of melancholy pervaded the abandoned house.
She fell into a melancholy mood after the farewell.
words.trap: melancholy شدیدتر از sadness است و بار ادبی و هنری دارد.

words.coreMeaning: دارای تغییرات سریع و غیرقابل پیش‌بینی
definitions: Subject to sudden or unpredictable changes of mood or mind
Volatile and changeable in temperament
examples: Her mercurial temperament made it hard to know what to expect.
The mercurial weather changed from sunshine to rain in minutes.
words.trap: mercurial از Mercury (سیاره عطارد) آمده که سریع حرکت می‌کند. با volatile فرق دارد: mercurial بیشتر درباره شخصیت است.

words.coreMeaning: رد کردن یا چشم‌پوشی کردن از چیزی
definitions: To reject or renounce something desired or valuable
To deny oneself something; to give up
examples: She abnegated all worldly pleasures.
He abnegated his claim to the throne.
words.trap: abnegate و negate متفاوت‌اند. abnegate به معنای رد کردن با اراده است.

words.coreMeaning: تقدیر و تحسین رسمی
definitions: An award or privilege granted as a special honor
An expression of praise or approval
examples: The film received many accolades from critics.
Winning the Nobel Prize is the highest accolade for a scientist.
words.trap: accolade اغلب به صورت جمع (accolades) استفاده می‌شود.

words.coreMeaning: تندی و تلخی در رفتار یا گفتار
definitions: Bitterness or ill feeling in speech or manner
Sharp and harsh in temper or tone
examples: The divorce was marked by great acrimony.
The debate was filled with acrimony and personal attacks.
words.trap: acrimonious (صفت) بسیار رایج‌تر از acrimony (اسم) است.

words.coreMeaning: ترکیب دو یا چند چیز در یک واحد
definitions: To combine or unite to form one organization or structure
To merge or blend together
examples: The two companies amalgamated to form a larger corporation.
Different cultures amalgamated over centuries.
words.trap: amalgamate با amalgam (ماده مخلوط دندان‌پزشکی) هم‌ریشه است.

words.coreMeaning: غیرعادی و متفاوت از انتظار
definitions: Deviating from what is standard, normal, or expected
Inconsistent with or deviating from what is usual or expected
examples: The anomalous test results puzzled the researchers.
Her anomalous behavior raised suspicions.
words.trap: anomaly (اسم) و anomalous (صفت) هم‌ریشه‌اند.

words.coreMeaning: داستانی که احتمالاً جعلی است اما معروف شده
definitions: Of doubtful authenticity, although widely circulated as being true
Fictitious; invented but widely believed
examples: The apocryphal story about the president is probably not true.
Many apocryphal tales surround the founding of the city.
words.trap: apocryphal از Apocrypha (کتب مقدس جعلی) آمده.

words.coreMeaning: وظیفه یا لازم بودن انجام کاری
definitions: To be necessary or proper for someone to do something
To be incumbent upon; to be one's duty
examples: It behooves us to listen to the advice of experts.
It would behoove you to arrive on time.
words.trap: behoove همیشه با it شروع می‌شود: 'It behooves you to...'

words.coreMeaning: تسلیم شدن رسمی یا پذیرش شرایط
definitions: The action of surrendering or ceasing to resist
An instance of surrendering under agreed conditions
examples: The capitulation of the army ended the war.
His capitulation to their demands was seen as weakness.
words.trap: capitulation شدیدتر از surrender است و بار منفی بیشتری دارد.

words.coreMeaning: محدود کردن در چارچوب مشخص
definitions: To restrict or limit something
To define the limits of; to confine within bounds
examples: Their freedom was severely circumscribed by the new laws.
The professor circumscribed the topic to fit the time limit.
words.trap: circumscribe با circumspect (محتاط) اشتباه نگیرید.

words.coreMeaning: آماده پذیرش پیشنهاد یا تغییر
definitions: Open and responsive to suggestion; easily persuaded
Liable to be brought to account; answerable
examples: She was amenable to changing the schedule.
He proved amenable to the new approach.
words.trap: amenable همیشه با to می‌آید: amenable to something.

words.coreMeaning: بسیار مناسب و مرتبط با موقعیت
definitions: Apt in the circumstances or in relation to something
Highly pertinent or appropriate
examples: Her apposite remark changed the course of the discussion.
He made an apposite comparison to illustrate his point.
words.trap: apposite با opposite (مخالف) اشتباه نگیرید!

words.coreMeaning: با قطعیت کشف یا مشخص کردن
definitions: To find something out for certain; to make sure of
To determine with certainty
examples: The investigators ascertained the cause of the fire.
We need to ascertain whether the plan is feasible.
words.trap: ascertain با assure (اطمینان دادن) اشتباه نگیرید.

words.coreMeaning: قابل ترکیب یا هماهنگ با هم
definitions: Able to exist or occur together without conflict
Well suited or in harmony with something
examples: They are highly compatible and work well together.
The software is compatible with all operating systems.
words.trap: compatible با with می‌آید نه to. اشتباه رایج: compatible to ✗ / compatible with ✓

words.coreMeaning: احساس پشیمانی یا تردید اخلاقی
definitions: A feeling of guilt or moral scruple that prevents wrongdoing
A feeling of uneasiness about doing something wrong
examples: He felt no compunction about lying to protect his friend.
She had no compunction in firing the dishonest employee.
words.trap: اغلب به صورت منفی استفاده می‌شود: 'no compunction' یعنی هیچ احساس گناهی نداشتن.

words.coreMeaning: مایه بحث و اختلاف نظر
definitions: Causing or likely to cause disagreement or argument
Given to arguing; quarrelsome
examples: The contentious issue divided the committee.
Immigration remains a contentious topic in politics.
words.trap: contentious هم به مسائل بحث‌برانگیز و هم به افراد ستیزه‌جو اطلاق می‌شود.

words.coreMeaning: بسیار ترسو و بی‌جرأت
definitions: Contemptibly lacking in courage; cowardly
Lacking even the rudiments of courage
examples: The craven soldier fled from the battlefield.
It was a craven act of betrayal.
words.trap: craven بار بسیار منفی‌تری از cowardly دارد و نشان‌دهنده تحقیر شدید است.

words.coreMeaning: به تعویق انداختن یا تبعیت کردن از نظر دیگری
definitions: To put off action to a later time; postpone
To yield respectfully to the opinion of another
examples: The committee decided to defer the decision until next month.
She deferred to her colleague's greater experience.
words.trap: defer دو معنای کاملاً متفاوت دارد: به تأخیر انداختن و احترام گذاشتن. باید از context فهمید.

words.coreMeaning: به سخره گرفتن و تمسخر کردن
definitions: To express contempt for; ridicule
To laugh at with contempt or scorn
examples: Critics derided the film as amateurish.
His ideas were derided by the academic establishment.
words.trap: deride و ridicule مترادف‌اند اما deride رسمی‌تر و جدی‌تر است.

words.coreMeaning: بدون نظم و هدف مشخص
definitions: Lacking a plan, purpose, or enthusiasm
Occurring randomly or occasionally; not methodical
examples: They had a desultory conversation about nothing in particular.
His desultory study habits resulted in poor grades.
words.trap: desultory فقط بی‌هدف نیست، بلکه بی‌حوصله و بی‌انگیزه هم هست.

words.coreMeaning: طراحی شده برای آموزش یا نصیحت
definitions: Intended to teach, particularly in having moral instruction
In the manner of a teacher, particularly in an obtrusive way
examples: The novel has a strongly didactic purpose.
His didactic approach bored the students.
words.trap: didactic اغلب بار منفی دارد و به معنای نصیحت‌گویی آزاردهنده است.

words.coreMeaning: عدم موافقت با نظر غالب
definitions: The expression of disagreement with a prevailing opinion
To disagree with the opinion of the majority
examples: There was widespread dissent against the new policy.
She dissented from the majority view.
words.trap: dissent (مخالفت) و descent (فرود) تلفظ مشابه دارند اما معنای متفاوت.

words.coreMeaning: کاهش خشم یا ناراحتی کسی
definitions: To appease the anger or anxiety of someone
To soften or make less severe
examples: She tried to mollify the angry customer with a refund.
His apology did little to mollify her feelings.
words.trap: mollify با modify (تغییر دادن) اشتباه نگیرید. mollify به معنای آرام کردن است.

words.coreMeaning: سرسختانه مقاوم در برابر تغییر
definitions: Stubbornly refusing to change one's opinion or course of action
Hardened and unyielding in feelings
examples: The obdurate negotiator refused to compromise.
His obdurate refusal to listen frustrated everyone.
words.trap: obdurate و obstinate مترادف‌اند اما obdurate رسمی‌تر و شدیدتر است.

words.coreMeaning: غیرمستقیم یا مورب
definitions: Neither parallel nor at right angles; slanting
Not expressed directly; indirect or evasive
examples: She made an oblique reference to his failure.
The oblique angle of the sunlight created long shadows.
words.trap: oblique reference یعنی اشاره غیرمستقیم. مراقب باشید از indirect و oblique در جای درست استفاده کنید.

words.coreMeaning: سرکش و پرسروصدا، غیرقابل کنترل
definitions: Noisy and difficult to control
Unruly and resistant to discipline
examples: The obstreperous child disrupted the entire class.
An obstreperous crowd gathered outside the courthouse.
words.trap: obstreperous هم سروصدا و هم سرکشی را شامل می‌شود. فقط پرسروصدا نیست.

words.coreMeaning: شرمساری شدید و تحقیر عمومی
definitions: Harsh criticism or censure; public disgrace arising from shameful conduct
The state of being strongly disapproved of
examples: The scandal brought opprobrium upon the entire family.
He bore the opprobrium of being labeled a traitor.
words.trap: opprobrium و opprobrious از یک ریشه‌اند اما opprobrium بیشتر به صورت اسم استفاده می‌شود.

words.coreMeaning: اظهاری که ظاهراً متناقض اما ممکن است حقیقی باشد
definitions: A seemingly contradictory statement that may be true
A situation that seems impossible but is actually true
examples: It's a paradox that the richest country has so many poor people.
The grandfather paradox is a famous thought experiment in physics.
words.trap: paradox با contradiction فرق دارد. paradox می‌تواند حقیقی باشد اما contradiction همیشه غلط است.

words.coreMeaning: حامی شدید یک حزب یا عقیده
definitions: A strong supporter of a party, cause, or person
Prejudiced in favor of a particular cause; biased
examples: The debate became highly partisan.
Partisan politics has divided the country.
words.trap: partisan می‌تواند مثبت (مقاومت‌گر) یا منفی (متعصب) باشد بسته به context.

words.coreMeaning: چیزی که به عنوان تضمین ارائه می‌شود یا مرتبط جانبی
definitions: Something pledged as security for repayment of a loan
Side by side; parallel; additional but subordinate
examples: He put up his house as collateral for the loan.
There was collateral damage from the bombing.
words.trap: collateral damage (آسیب جانبی) یک اصطلاح نظامی رایج است.

words.coreMeaning: احساس وحشت و نگرانی شدید
definitions: Feelings of anxiety or dismay, typically at something unexpected
A state of paralyzing dismay
examples: To her consternation, the door was locked.
The announcement caused consternation among the employees.
words.trap: consternation با constipation (یبوست) اشتباه نگیرید! تلفظ متفاوتی دارند.

words.coreMeaning: به سمت یک نقطه مشترک حرکت کردن
definitions: To come together from different directions so as to meet
To tend toward a common result or conclusion
examples: The roads converge at the town center.
Their opinions converged after long discussions.
words.trap: converge و diverge متضاد هستند. converge به معنای به هم رسیدن و diverge به معنای از هم دور شدن.

words.coreMeaning: بسیار پیچیده و دشوار برای فهم
definitions: Extremely complex and difficult to follow
Having many twists and turns; coiled
examples: The plot of the novel was so convoluted that few understood it.
His convoluted explanation confused everyone.
words.trap: convoluted بار منفی دارد و به معنای غیرضروری پیچیده است.

words.coreMeaning: تخریب تدریجی توسط واکنش شیمیایی
definitions: To destroy or damage metal gradually by chemical action
To undermine or destroy gradually
examples: Salt water can corrode metal surfaces.
Corruption corrodes public trust in government.
words.trap: corrosive (مخرب) هم به معنای فیزیکی و هم انتزاعی است.

words.coreMeaning: شدیداً تضعیف کردن
definitions: To make someone weak and infirm
To impair the strength of; to weaken
examples: The disease debilitated him for months.
The economic crisis debilitated the country's infrastructure.
words.trap: debilitating بسیار رایج‌تر از debilitate است.

words.coreMeaning: بسیار فرسوده و ضعیف بر اثر سن یا استفاده
definitions: Worn out or ruined because of old age or neglect
In a state of disrepair or ruin as a result of age or neglect
examples: The decrepit building was scheduled for demolition.
The decrepit old man could barely walk.
words.trap: decrepit و discreet (محتاط) تلفظ مشابهی دارند اما معنای متفاوت.

words.coreMeaning: رهبری که با تحریک احساسات مردم قدرت می‌گیرد
definitions: A political leader who seeks support by appealing to emotions and prejudices
A leader who obtains power by means of impassioned appeals to the emotions and prejudices
examples: The demagogue exploited the fears of the population.
History is full of demagogues who rose to power through lies.
words.trap: demagogue با democrat (دمکرات) متفاوت است. demagogue بار منفی شدیدی دارد.

words.coreMeaning: رها شده و در حال تخریب
definitions: In a very poor condition as a result of disuse and neglect
A person without a home, job, or property
examples: The derelict warehouse was infested with rats.
The harbor was full of derelict ships.
words.trap: dereliction of duty (ترک وظیفه) یک اصطلاح حقوقی مهم است.

words.coreMeaning: حمله شدید لفظی و انتقاد تند
definitions: A forceful and bitter verbal attack against someone or something
A prolonged and bitter speech or piece of writing
examples: The senator launched into a diatribe against the media.
His diatribe against corruption lasted for an hour.
words.trap: diatribe با dialogue (گفتگو) متفاوت است. diatribe یک‌طرفه و خصمانه است.

words.coreMeaning: بی‌ارزش جلوه دادن کسی یا چیزی
definitions: To regard or represent as being of little worth
To speak of in a slighting or derogatory way
examples: She disparaged his efforts in front of the team.
Don't disparage someone's work without offering alternatives.
words.trap: disparage با disparate (متفاوت) اشتباه نگیرید!

words.coreMeaning: پایان رسمی یا فروپاشی
definitions: The closing down or dismissal of an assembly or partnership
The action of dissolving or the process of being dissolved
examples: The dissolution of the parliament led to new elections.
The dissolution of the empire took decades.
words.trap: dissolution با solution (حل) از یک ریشه‌اند اما معنای متفاوتی دارند.

words.coreMeaning: انتقاد شدید و طولانی
definitions: To scold or criticize someone angrily
To rebuke someone at length in an angry way
examples: The coach berated the team for their poor performance.
She berated herself for making such a silly mistake.
words.trap: berate شدیدتر از scold و rebuke است.

words.coreMeaning: مربوط به زندگی ساده روستایی
definitions: Relating to the pleasant aspects of the countryside and country life
Of or relating to shepherds; pastoral
examples: The bucolic landscape inspired many poets.
They escaped the city for a bucolic retreat in the countryside.
words.trap: bucolic همیشه مثبت نیست؛ می‌تواند به معنای ساده‌لوحانه هم باشد.

words.coreMeaning: دارای ظاهر مرتب و شیک
definitions: Neat and trim in dress and appearance
Neat, attractive, and well-dressed
examples: The dapper gentleman walked into the room.
He always looked dapper in his tailored suits.
words.trap: dapper معمولاً برای مردان استفاده می‌شود.

words.coreMeaning: دارای حباب یا سرشار از انرژی و شادی
definitions: Giving off bubbles; fizzy
Vivacious and enthusiastic
examples: She has an effervescent personality that lights up the room.
The effervescent drink fizzed when opened.
words.trap: هم معنای فیزیکی (جوشان) و هم معنای شخصیتی (شاد) دارد. مراقب context باشید.

words.coreMeaning: بی‌پروایی شرم‌آور و توهین‌آمیز
definitions: Insolent or impertinent behavior
Extreme rudeness or boldness
examples: He had the effrontery to demand a raise after being late all week.
She refused to tolerate such effrontery.
words.trap: effrontery و effervescence شکل مشابه دارند اما معنای کاملاً متفاوتی دارند.

words.coreMeaning: شعر یا آهنگی غم‌انگیز برای مرده
definitions: A poem of serious reflection, typically a lament for the dead
A mournful or reflective piece of music
examples: He wrote an elegy for his departed friend.
Gray's 'Elegy Written in a Country Churchyard' is a masterpiece.
words.trap: elegy (مرثیه) و eulogy (ستایش‌نامه) هر دو درباره مرده‌اند اما elegy غم‌انگیز و eulogy ستایش‌گر است.

words.coreMeaning: مبتنی بر مشاهده و تجربه عملی
definitions: Based on observation or experience rather than theory
Relying on practical experience rather than abstract reasoning
examples: The theory must be supported by empirical evidence.
Empirical research has shown the treatment to be effective.
words.trap: empirical به معنای تجربی است، نه تجربه شخصی. در علم به معنای قابل مشاهده و آزمایش است.

words.coreMeaning: به وجود آوردن یا سبب شدن
definitions: To cause or give rise to a feeling, situation, or condition
To produce or create; to bring into existence
examples: The policy change engendered widespread opposition.
Trust is engendered through consistent honesty.
words.trap: engender بیشتر برای احساسات و شرایط انتزاعی استفاده می‌شود، نه اشیاء فیزیکی.

words.coreMeaning: دارای دانش وسیع و عمیق
definitions: Having or showing great knowledge or learning
Characterized by extensive reading or knowledge
examples: The erudite professor lectured on ancient civilizations.
Her erudite commentary impressed the scholars.
words.trap: erudition (دانش) و erudite (عالم) از یک ریشه‌اند. با elegant (ظریف) اشتباه نگیرید.

words.coreMeaning: پذیرفتن و حمایت از یک عقیده یا ایده
definitions: To adopt or support a cause, belief, or way of life
To give one's loyalty or support to
examples: She espoused the cause of environmental protection.
He espoused a philosophy of non-violence.
words.trap: espouse با spouse (همسر) هم‌خانواده نیست! ریشه لاتین متفاوتی دارند.

words.coreMeaning: استفاده از کلمات ملایم به جای کلمات ناخوشایند
definitions: A mild or indirect word substituted for one considered too harsh or blunt
An expression used in place of something unpleasant
examples: 'Passed away' is a euphemism for 'died'.
Using 'downsizing' as a euphemism for firing employees is common.
words.trap: euphemism (تعبیر ملایم) و dysphemism (تعبیر زشت) متضاد هستند.

words.coreMeaning: از اتهام یا گناه رها کردن
definitions: To clear from blame or guilt
To prove that someone is not guilty of wrongdoing
examples: New evidence exculpated the defendant.
The investigation exculpated the officer of any misconduct.
words.trap: exculpate با incriminate (متهم کردن) متضاد است. exculpatory evidence = دلیل تبرئه.

words.coreMeaning: کاهش شدت تقصیر یا جرم با ارائه دلایل
definitions: To lessen the severity of guilt or an offense by offering partial excuses
To make less serious by way of excuse
examples: Nothing can extenuate his crime.
The lawyer tried to extenuate the circumstances of the offense.
words.trap: extenuating circumstances بسیار رایج است. به معنای شرایطی است که تقصیر را کم‌تر می‌کند.

words.coreMeaning: از اطلاعات موجود نتیجه‌گیری کردن برای موارد جدید
definitions: To extend the application of a method or conclusion to an unknown situation
To project or extend known data into an unknown area
examples: From the current trend, we can extrapolate future sales.
Scientists extrapolated the results to a larger population.
words.trap: extrapolate (بیرون‌یابی) و interpolate (درون‌یابی) متضاد هستند.

words.coreMeaning: وجود مقدار بسیار کم از چیزی
definitions: The presence of something only in small or insufficient quantities
Scarcity; dearth
examples: There is a paucity of evidence to support the claim.
The paucity of resources hampered the research.
words.trap: paucity و scarcity مترادف‌اند اما paucity رسمی‌تر و ادبی‌تر است.

words.coreMeaning: تأکید بیش از حد بر جزئیات و قواعد
definitions: Of or like a pedant; overly concerned with minute details or formalisms
Excessively concerned with minor details and rules
examples: His pedantic insistence on grammar annoyed his colleagues.
The professor's pedantic style made the lecture boring.
words.trap: pedantic بار منفی دارد. pedant (آدم دقیق‌گیر) هم منفی است و به کسی اطلاق می‌شود که بیش از حد به جزئیات توجه می‌کند.

words.coreMeaning: علاقه یا تمایل قوی به چیزی
definitions: A strong or habitual liking for something
An inclination or taste for something
examples: She has a penchant for luxury goods.
He showed a penchant for dramatic gestures.
words.trap: penchant از فرانسوی آمده و همیشه با for می‌آید: a penchant for something.

words.coreMeaning: دارای ارتباط مستقیم با موضوع
definitions: Relevant or applicable to a particular matter
Having a clear and decisive bearing on the issue at hand
examples: Please keep your comments pertinent to the discussion.
The lawyer asked pertinent questions during the trial.
words.trap: impertinent (بی‌ربط یا گستاخ) متضاد pertinent است اما معنای دوم آن (گستاخ) بسیار رایج‌تر است.

words.coreMeaning: گسترش یافته در همه جا
definitions: Spreading widely throughout an area or group of people
Existing in or spreading through every part of something
examples: The pervasive influence of social media is undeniable.
A pervasive sense of anxiety affected the whole community.
words.trap: pervasive معمولاً بار منفی خفیفی دارد اما می‌تواند خنثی هم باشد.

words.coreMeaning: دارای ایمان و تقوا
definitions: Devoutly religious; showing reverence for God
Making a hypocritical display of virtue
examples: She was a pious woman who attended church daily.
His pious words were contradicted by his actions.
words.trap: pious می‌تواند منفی باشد (رياكارانه) یا مثبت (متدین واقعی). context مهم است.

words.coreMeaning: تأکید بر عقاید خود بدون توجه به شواهد
definitions: Inclined to lay down principles as incontrovertibly true
Asserting opinions in a doctrinaire or arrogant manner
examples: His dogmatic approach to teaching frustrated the students.
She was dogmatic about the superiority of her methods.
words.trap: dogmatic بار منفی دارد و به معنای متعصبانه و غیرمنعطف است.

words.coreMeaning: واضح و قابل فهم کردن
definitions: To make something clear; to explain
To throw light upon; to clarify
examples: The professor elucidated the complex theory.
Could you elucidate your point further?
words.trap: elucidate و illustrate متفاوت‌اند. elucidate به معنای توضیح دادن و illustrate به معنای مثال زدن.

words.coreMeaning: از بین بردن انرژی و نیرو
definitions: To cause someone to feel drained of energy or vitality
To weaken or deprive of force or strength
examples: The tropical heat enervated the travelers.
Long hours of work enervated the staff.
words.trap: enervate با energize (انرژی دادن) متضاد است! این یکی از گمراه‌کننده‌ترین کلمات است.

words.coreMeaning: مرتبط نبودن یا غیرضروری بودن
definitions: Irrelevant or unrelated to the subject being dealt with
Coming from outside; not essential
examples: Please remove all extraneous details from the report.
Extraneous noise distracted the students.
words.trap: extraneous با extraordinary (فوق‌العاده) اشتباه نگیرید.

words.coreMeaning: خشنود و راضی کردن
definitions: To give someone pleasure or satisfaction
To satisfy or indulge a desire or appetite
examples: She was gratified by the positive response.
The results gratified even the most skeptical critics.
words.trap: instant gratification (ارضای فوری) یک اصطلاح روانشناسی مهم است.

words.coreMeaning: خنده بلند و ناگهانی
definitions: A loud and hearty laugh
To laugh loudly and boisterously
examples: The audience burst into guffaws at the comedian's joke.
He guffawed at the absurdity of the situation.
words.trap: guffaw بسیار بلندتر از chuckle (خنده آرام) است.

words.coreMeaning: ظاهر خسته و فرسوده بر اثر نگرانی یا بیماری
definitions: Looking exhausted and unwell, especially from fatigue, worry, or suffering
Wild-looking; gaunt
examples: She looked haggard after weeks of sleepless nights.
The haggard faces of the refugees told their story.
words.trap: haggard با haggle (چانه زدن) اشتباه نگیرید.

words.coreMeaning: چیزی که نشانه وقوع چیز دیگری است
definitions: A person or thing that announces or signals the approach of another
Something that precedes and indicates the approach of something else
examples: The first robin is a harbinger of spring.
The economic downturn was a harbinger of worse things to come.
words.trap: harbinger با harbor (بندر) هم‌ریشه نیست! از فرانسوی قدیم herbergier آمده.

words.coreMeaning: اتهام رسمی زدن به مقام دولتی
definitions: To charge a public official with misconduct in office
To challenge the credibility of; to call into question
examples: The president was impeached by Congress.
The witness's testimony was impeached by the defense.
words.trap: impeach به معنای اخراج نیست! فقط به معنای اتهام زدن رسمی است.

words.coreMeaning: قابل توقف نبودن بر اثر خستگی
definitions: Persisting tirelessly; never giving up
Incapable of being fatigued; not yielding to weariness
examples: She was an indefatigable advocate for children's rights.
His indefatigable spirit inspired the entire team.
words.trap: indefatigable از لاتین defatigare (خسته کردن) با پیشوند否定ی in- آمده.

words.coreMeaning: عدم تمایل به سازش یا تغییر
definitions: Unwilling to change one's views or to agree about something
Refusing to compromise; uncompromising
examples: The intransigent union refused to accept the deal.
Both sides remained intransigent throughout the negotiations.
words.trap: intransigent بسیار رسمی‌تر از stubborn است و اغلب در سیاست استفاده می‌شود.

words.coreMeaning: بسیار شجاع و بی‌باک
definitions: Fearless; adventurous; brave
Resolute and fearless in the face of danger
examples: The intrepid explorer ventured into uncharted territory.
Her intrepid courage saved many lives.
words.trap: intrepid با trepidation (وحشت) از یک ریشه‌اند اما معنای متضادی دارند!

words.coreMeaning: مهارت در فریب دادن یا تردستی
definitions: Skillful use of the hands to perform tricks; sleight of hand
Trickery or deception
examples: The magician's legerdemain amazed the audience.
Financial legerdemain hid the company's losses.
words.trap: legerdemain از فرانسوی légère de main (دست سبک) آمده.

words.coreMeaning: اعتقاد به برابری همه انسان‌ها
definitions: Relating to or believing in the principle that all people are equal
Advocating equal rights for all
examples: She holds egalitarian views on education.
The egalitarian society treated all citizens equally.
words.trap: egalitarianism (برابری‌خواهی) با feminism (فمینیسم) متفاوت اما مرتبط است.

words.coreMeaning: احساس خستگی و بی‌حوصلگی ناشی از یکنواختی
definitions: A feeling of listlessness and dissatisfaction arising from a lack of excitement
Boredom; tedium
examples: The ennui of suburban life drove her to seek adventure.
A sense of ennui pervaded the office on Monday mornings.
words.trap: ennui از فرانسوی آمده و تلفظ آن برای انگلیسی‌زبانان دشوار است: /ɒnˈwiː/.

words.coreMeaning: توجه بیش از حد به جزئیات و کیفیت
definitions: Very attentive to and concerned about accuracy and detail
Hard to please; excessively particular
examples: She is fastidious about keeping her house clean.
The fastidious editor caught every typo.
words.trap: fastidious بار منفی خفیفی دارد و به معنای وسواسی بیش از حد است.

words.coreMeaning: ویژگی منحصربه‌فرد و عجیب فردی
definitions: A mode of behavior or way of thought peculiar to an individual
A distinctive or peculiar feature or characteristic
examples: Everyone has their own idiosyncrasies.
The car's idiosyncrasies made it difficult to drive.
words.trap: idiosyncrasy و idiosyncratic (صفت) بسیار رایج‌اند.

words.coreMeaning: کاهش ترس یا نگرانی
definitions: To diminish fear, suspicion, or worry.
To calm or pacify.
examples: The doctor tried to allay the patient's fears.
The government took steps to allay public concerns.
words.trap: با 'ally' (متحد) و 'alley' (کوچه) اشتباه نگیرید

words.coreMeaning: وفاداری یا دقت در اجرا یا بازتولید
definitions: Faithfulness to a person, cause, or belief
The degree of exactness with which something is reproduced
examples: He showed unwavering fidelity to his principles.
The recording was reproduced with high fidelity.
words.trap: infidelity (خیانت) متضاد fidelity (وفاداری) است. 'hi-fi' از high fidelity آمده.

words.coreMeaning: نداشتن جدیت لازم در مواجهه با موضوع مهم
definitions: Not showing a serious or respectful attitude
Treating serious issues with inappropriate humor
examples: His flippant remarks about the accident angered everyone.
She gave a flippant answer to a serious question.
words.trap: flippant بار منفی دارد و به معنای بی‌احترامی در موقعیت جدی است.

words.coreMeaning: قوی‌تر کردن از نظر فیزیکی یا روحی
definitions: To strengthen a place with defensive works
To invigorate mentally or physically
examples: They fortified the city walls against attack.
She fortified herself with a cup of coffee before the meeting.
words.trap: fortified wine (شراب تقویت‌شده) یعنی شرابی که الکل اضافه شده. با strengthen کمی فرق دارد.

words.coreMeaning: نیرو یا انگیزه‌ای که باعث حرکت یا اقدام می‌شود
definitions: The force or energy behind an action or movement
Something that makes a process happen more quickly
examples: The scandal gave impetus to the reform movement.
The new funding provided the impetus for research.
words.trap: impetus جمع ندارد و همیشه به صورت singular استفاده می‌شود.

words.coreMeaning: غیرقابل اصلاح یا تغییر
definitions: Not able to be corrected, improved, or reformed
Deeply rooted and unlikely to change
examples: He is an incorrigible optimist despite all setbacks.
The incorrigible liar could not be trusted.
words.trap: incorrigible می‌تواند هم منفی (دروغ‌گوی اصلاح‌ناپذیر) و هم مثبت/خنثی (خوش‌بین اصلاح‌ناپذیر) باشد.

words.coreMeaning: ساده و صادق، بدون ریاکاری
definitions: Innocent and unsuspecting; candid
Showing childlike simplicity and naivety
examples: Her ingenuous nature made her easy to deceive.
He gave an ingenuous smile that won everyone over.
words.trap: ingenuous (ساده‌لوح) و ingenious (باهوش) بسیار شبیه‌اند اما معنای متفاوتی دارند!

words.coreMeaning: غیرقابل فهم یا تفسیر
definitions: Impossible to understand or interpret
Enigmatic and mysterious in character
examples: Her inscrutable expression gave no hint of her feelings.
The inscrutable workings of fate surprised everyone.
words.trap: inscrutable بیشتر برای افراد و چهره‌ها استفاده می‌شود. با obscure (مبهم) فرق دارد.

words.coreMeaning: سخت‌تر از آنکه بتوان کنترل یا حل کرد
definitions: Hard to control, manage, or deal with
Not easily governed, managed, or directed
examples: The intractable conflict has lasted for decades.
She struggled with an intractable problem in mathematics.
words.trap: intractable و untractable هر دو صحیح‌اند اما intractable رایج‌تر است.

words.coreMeaning: رفتار سبک و غیرجدی
definitions: Humor or lightheartedness, especially the treatment of a serious matter with humor
Lack of appropriate seriousness
examples: His levity during the meeting was inappropriate.
A little levity can ease tension in difficult situations.
words.trap: levity با levitate (معلق شدن) اشتباه نگیرید.

words.coreMeaning: فرد قدرتمند و ثروتمند در صنعت
definitions: A wealthy or influential person, especially in business or industry
A person of great influence or importance
examples: The media magnate owned several newspapers and TV stations.
He became a real estate magnate through hard work.
words.trap: magnate و magnet (آهنربا) تلفظ مشابه دارند اما معنای متفاوت.

words.coreMeaning: داشتن قصد بد و آسیب‌رسان
definitions: Having or showing a wish to do evil to others
Having an intensely harmful or hostile disposition
examples: The malevolent villain plotted the hero's downfall.
A malevolent force seemed to be at work.
words.trap: malevolent و benevolent متضاد هستند. هر دو از لاتین volens (خواهان) آمده‌اند.

words.coreMeaning: عادت به دروغ‌گویی
definitions: Not telling the truth; lying habitually
False; untrue; deceitful
examples: The mendacious witness was charged with perjury.
His mendacious claims were exposed by the investigation.
words.trap: mendacious شدیدتر از dishonest است و بار ادبی دارد.

words.coreMeaning: جذاب در ظاهر اما بی‌ارزش در باطن
definitions: Apparently attractive but having no real value or integrity
Flashily attractive; showily alluring
examples: The meretricious jewelry turned out to be cheap imitation.
His meretricious charm concealed a ruthless ambition.
words.trap: meretricious با meritorious (شایسته) اشتباه نگیرید! معنای متضادی دارند.

words.coreMeaning: ناتوان در دیدن دور یا فکر کردن بلندمدت
definitions: Nearsighted; unable to see distant objects clearly
Lacking imagination, foresight, or intellectual insight
examples: The myopic decision led to long-term problems.
His myopic view of the situation ignored important factors.
words.trap: myopia (نزدیک‌بینی) هم به معنای فیزیکی و هم به معنای فکری است.

words.coreMeaning: فردی در ابتدای راه یادگیری
definitions: A person who is new to a subject, skill, or belief
A beginner or novice
examples: As a neophyte in politics, he made several rookie mistakes.
The cooking class was designed for neophytes.
words.trap: neophyte با novice مترادف است اما neophyte رسمی‌تر و ادبی‌تر.

words.coreMeaning: مقاوم سرسختانه در برابر تغییر
definitions: Stubbornly refusing to change one's opinion or chosen course of action
Difficult to overcome or dispel
examples: The obstinate child refused to eat his vegetables.
Her obstinate refusal to compromise delayed the project.
words.trap: obstinate با obdurate مترادف‌اند اما obstinate رایج‌تر است.

words.coreMeaning: دخالت ناخواسته و آزاردهنده
definitions: Asserting authority in an annoyingly domineering way
Intrusively enthusiastic in offering help or advice
examples: The officious clerk insisted on checking every document.
Her officious behavior annoyed her colleagues.
words.trap: officious با official (رسمی) اشتباه نگیرید! officious بار منفی دارد.

words.coreMeaning: الگوی غالب برای تفکر یا عمل
definitions: A typical example or pattern of something; a model
A standard or pattern that serves as a model
examples: The discovery of DNA was a paradigm shift in biology.
The old paradigm of business no longer applies.
words.trap: paradigm shift (تغییر الگو) یک اصطلاح بسیار مهم در فلسفه علم است.

words.coreMeaning: خیانت‌آمیز و غیرقابل اعتماد
definitions: Deceitful and untrustworthy; treacherous
Deliberately faithless; guilty of betrayal
examples: The perfidious ally betrayed them at the crucial moment.
His perfidious actions were condemned by all.
words.trap: perfidious و treacherous مترادف‌اند اما perfidious ادبی‌تر و شاعرانه‌تر است.

words.coreMeaning: دارای درک و تشخیص سریع و دقیق
definitions: Having a ready insight into and understanding of things; shrewd
Keen in mental perception and understanding
examples: The perspicacious detective noticed the smallest clue.
Her perspicacious analysis revealed the hidden flaw.
words.trap: perspicacious با perspicuous (واضح) متفاوت است. perspicacious درباره شخص و perspicuous درباره بیان.

words.coreMeaning: علاقه به بهبود وضعیت بشریت
definitions: The desire to promote the welfare of others, typically through generous donations
An act of goodwill toward fellow human beings
examples: His philanthropy has funded schools and hospitals.
Corporate philanthropy is on the rise.
words.trap: philanthropy با misanthropy (بدبینی به انسان‌ها) متضاد است.

words.coreMeaning: اظهاری تکراری و بی‌ارزش
definitions: A remark or statement that has been used too often to be interesting or thoughtful
A trite, meaningless, or prosaic statement
examples: The speech was full of platitudes but offered no real solutions.
He offered only platitudes when concrete action was needed.
words.trap: platitude بار منفی شدیدی دارد و به معنای حرف بی‌محتواست.

words.coreMeaning: شامل همه، بدون استثنا
definitions: Unqualified; absolute; attended by all members
Full; complete; entire
examples: The plenary session was attended by all delegates.
The ambassador was given plenary powers.
words.trap: plenary session (نشست عمومی) یک اصطلاح پارلمانی رایج است.

words.coreMeaning: مربوط به بحث و جدل شدید
definitions: Of or involving strongly critical, controversial, or disputatious writing or speech
Engaged in or involving heated controversy
examples: The polemical essay sparked a national debate.
His polemical style made him many enemies.
words.trap: polemical از لاتین polemos (جنگ) آمده و به معنای جدلی است.

words.coreMeaning: رشد ذهنی یا جسمی زودتر از معمول
definitions: Having developed certain abilities at an earlier age than usual
Showing mature qualities at an unusually early age
examples: The precocious child was reading at the age of three.
Her precocious talent was recognized early by her teachers.
words.trap: precocious فقط برای کودکان استفاده می‌شود، نه بزرگسالان.

words.coreMeaning: اجتناب از گفتن حقیقت با حرف‌های مبهم
definitions: To speak or act in an evasive way
To avoid telling the truth by not directly answering a question
examples: Stop prevaricating and give me a straight answer.
The witness prevaricated during the cross-examination.
words.trap: prevaricate و procrastinate (تعلل) متفاوت‌اند! prevaricate به معنای حقیقت نگفتن است.

words.coreMeaning: صداقت و درستکاری کامل
definitions: The quality of having strong moral principles; honesty and decency
Complete and confirmed integrity
examples: A person of unquestioned probity was needed for the investigation.
His probity in financial matters was well known.
words.trap: probity شدیدتر از honesty است و بار رسمی و ادبی دارد.

words.coreMeaning: خرج کردن بیش از حد و بی‌محابا
definitions: Spending money or resources freely and recklessly; wasteful
Lavish; generous to excess
examples: The prodigal son returned home after squandering his inheritance.
Her prodigal spending habits left her in debt.
words.trap: prodigal son (پسر ولخرج) یک داستان معروف انجیلی است.

words.coreMeaning: افزایش سریع در تعداد
definitions: To increase rapidly in numbers; to multiply
To produce new growth or offspring rapidly
examples: Fake news stories proliferate on social media.
Fast-food restaurants have proliferated in recent years.
words.trap: nuclear proliferation (گسترش سلاح هسته‌ای) یک اصطلاح سیاسی مهم است.

words.coreMeaning: راضی کردن کسی که خشمگین است
definitions: To win or regain the favor of someone by doing something that pleases them
To appease or conciliate
examples: He tried to propitiate his angry boss with an apology.
Sacrifices were made to propitiate the gods.
words.trap: propitious (مبارک) از همین ریشه است اما معنای متفاوتی دارد.

words.coreMeaning: رفتار ناشایست برای بزرگسالان
definitions: Childishly silly and trivial
Of or relating to a child; juvenile
examples: His puerile jokes annoyed everyone at the dinner table.
The argument descended into puerile name-calling.
words.trap: puerile بار منفی شدیدتری از childish دارد و نشان‌دهنده تحقیر است.

words.coreMeaning: انتقاد شدید و سرزنش
definitions: To express sharp disapproval or criticism of someone
A sharp reprimand or criticism
examples: The teacher rebuked the student for cheating.
He received a stern rebuke from his superior.
words.trap: rebuke با refute (رد کردن) متفاوت است. rebuke به معنای سرزنش و refute به معنای رد کردن استدلال.

words.coreMeaning: بسیار پیچیده و قابل فهم فقط برای متخصصان
definitions: Little known; obscure; dealing with very profound or difficult subject matter
Beyond ordinary knowledge or understanding
examples: The book dealt with recondite aspects of quantum physics.
His recondite arguments confused even the experts.
words.trap: recondite با record (ضبط) اشتباه نگیرید.

words.coreMeaning: رد کردن شدید و قاطع
definitions: To refuse to accept or be associated with
To deny the truth or validity of something
examples: The government repudiated the treaty.
She repudiated the accusations against her.
words.trap: repudiate شدیدتر از reject است و بار رسمی دارد.

words.coreMeaning: در وضعیت خطرناک و ناپایدار
definitions: Not securely held or in position; dangerously likely to fall or collapse
Dependent on uncertain conditions; insecure
examples: The refugees lived in precarious conditions.
His financial situation was precarious after losing his job.
words.trap: precarious فقط به معنای فیزیکی نیست. اقتصادی و اجتماعی هم استفاده می‌شود.

words.coreMeaning: توانایی پیش‌بینی رویدادها قبل از وقوع
definitions: Having or showing knowledge of events before they take place
Having foresight or foreknowledge
examples: Her prescient warning about the financial crisis proved accurate.
The author's prescient novel predicted the rise of social media.
words.trap: prescient از لاتین praescire (از پیش دانستن) آمده. با present (حاضر) اشتباه نگیرید.

words.coreMeaning: تولیدکننده مقدار زیادی از چیزی
definitions: Present in large numbers or quantities; producing much fruit or many offspring
Producing a great deal of something
examples: She is a prolific writer with over fifty published novels.
The region is known for its prolific grape harvests.
words.trap: prolific معمولاً مثبت است اما می‌تواند خنثی هم باشد: 'prolific criminal'.

words.coreMeaning: تمایل طبیعی یا ارثی به رفتار خاص
definitions: An inclination or natural tendency to behave in a particular way
A natural inclination or preference
examples: He has a propensity for taking risks.
Her propensity to exaggerate undermined her credibility.
words.trap: propensity همیشه با for یا to می‌آید. بار منفی خفیفی دارد چون اغلب برای عادات بد استفاده می‌شود.

words.coreMeaning: فاقد تخیل و هیجان
definitions: Having the style or diction of prose; lacking poetic beauty
Commonplace; dull and unimaginative
examples: The truth was more prosaic than the rumors suggested.
He led a prosaic life in a small suburban town.
words.trap: prosaic از prose (نثر) آمده. یعنی مثل نثر خشک و بی‌آرایه، فاقد شاعرانگی.

words.coreMeaning: تمایل به سکوت و عدم افشای اطلاعات
definitions: Not revealing one's thoughts or feelings readily
Reserved and reluctant to speak
examples: He was reticent about his personal life.
She remained reticent during the entire meeting.
words.trap: reticent به معنای reluctant (بی‌میل) نیست! reticent فقط به معنای کم‌حرف است.

words.coreMeaning: دارای خرد و بصیرت عمیق
definitions: Having or showing keen mental discernment and good judgment; wise
Shrewd and discerning in practical matters
examples: The sagacious leader anticipated the crisis months in advance.
Her sagacious advice saved the company from bankruptcy.
words.trap: sagacious از sage (حكيم) آمده و شدیدتر از wise است. بار بسیار مثبتی دارد.

words.coreMeaning: بسیار مهم و قابل توجه
definitions: Most noticeable or important; prominent
Standing out conspicuously; projecting
examples: The salient points of the argument were clear.
She highlighted the salient features of the new product.
words.trap: salient point یک collocation بسیار رایج است. با silent (ساکت) اشتباه نگیرید!

words.coreMeaning: نیاز به نشستن طولانی یا کم‌تحرکی
definitions: Tending to spend much time seated; somewhat inactive
Requiring much sitting
examples: A sedentary lifestyle increases the risk of heart disease.
The sedentary nature of office work is bad for health.
words.trap: sedentary lifestyle یکی از رایج‌ترین collocation‌هاست. از sedan (ماشین) نمی‌آید!

words.coreMeaning: ایجاد خواب‌آلودگی یا کسالت
definitions: Tending to induce drowsiness or sleep
Causing a person to become dull and lethargic
examples: The soporific effect of the lecture put half the class to sleep.
The warm room had a soporific effect on the audience.
words.trap: soporific با specific شکل مشابه دارد اما معنای کاملاً متفاوتی دارد.

words.coreMeaning: ظاهر فریبنده داشتن اما در واقع نادرست
definitions: Superficially plausible, but actually wrong
Misleading in appearance, especially misleadingly attractive
examples: The specious argument fooled many people.
His specious reasoning was quickly exposed by the experts.
words.trap: specious با special اشتباه نگیرید! specious یعنی ظاهر زیبا اما باطن نادرست.

words.coreMeaning: جعلی یا غیرواقعی
definitions: Not being what it purports to be; false or fake
Not genuine, authentic, or true
examples: The claim was based on spurious evidence.
He was accused of making spurious allegations.
words.trap: spurious correlation (همبستگی جعلی) یک مفهوم آماری مهم است.

words.coreMeaning: فاقد احساسات و هیجانات ظاهری
definitions: Calm, dependable, and showing little emotion or animation
Having or revealing little emotion; unexcitable
examples: The stolid farmer showed no emotion at the news.
His stolid demeanor hid a deep well of feeling.
words.trap: stolid با stupid (احمق) فرق دارد. stolid به معنای بی‌احساس است نه احمق.

words.coreMeaning: انجام کاری به صورت مخفیانه و خفا
definitions: Kept secret, especially because it would not be approved of
Done in a stealthy or secretive manner
examples: She took a surreptitious glance at her phone.
His surreptitious dealings with the enemy were eventually exposed.
words.trap: surreptitious و furtive مترادف‌اند اما surreptitious بیشتر برای اعمال و furtive برای نگاه و رفتار است.

words.coreMeaning: فاقد انرژی و فعالیت
definitions: Mentally or physically inactive; lethargic
In a state of dormancy or hibernation
examples: The torpid economy showed no signs of recovery.
A torpid bear emerged from its winter sleep.
words.trap: torpid با torpid (حیوان خواب‌زده) هم استفاده می‌شود. از لاتین torpidus (بی‌حرکت) آمده.

words.coreMeaning: احساس ترس و اضطراب شدید
definitions: A feeling of fear or agitation about something that may happen
Trembling or quivering movement
examples: She approached the interview with trepidation.
He felt great trepidation about the upcoming surgery.
words.trap: trepidation با trepidation (ترس) و vibration (لرزش) فرق دارد. trepidation بیشتر احساسی است.

words.coreMeaning: بیش از حد چاپلوس و ریاکارانه
definitions: Excessively or ingratiatingly flattering; oily
Having an oily or greasy quality
examples: The unctuous salesman praised everything about the customer.
His unctuous manner made everyone uncomfortable.
words.trap: unctuous و obsequious مترادف‌اند اما unctuous بیشتر برای لحن و صداست و obsequious برای رفتار.

words.coreMeaning: عدم توانایی در تصمیم‌گیری
definitions: To alternate or waver between different opinions or actions
To be unable to decide between different opinions or actions
examples: She vacillated between accepting and rejecting the offer.
He vacillated so long that the opportunity passed.
words.trap: vacillate با oscillate (نوسان) متفاوت است. vacillate بیشتر درباره تصمیم‌گیری است.

words.coreMeaning: احترام عمیق و ستایش‌آمیز
definitions: To regard with great respect; revere
To honor or respect someone or something deeply
examples: The community venerates its elders.
She is venerated for her contributions to science.
words.trap: venerate و venerable (محترم) هم‌ریشه‌اند. venerable Father لقب کشیش‌های کاتولیک است.

words.coreMeaning: تمایل شدید به انتقام‌گیری
definitions: Having or showing a strong desire for revenge
Disposed to seek vengeance; vengeful
examples: She was vindictive and never forgave those who wronged her.
His vindictive actions only made the situation worse.
words.trap: vindictive (انتقام‌جو) و vindicate (تبرئه کردن) هم‌ریشه‌اند اما معنای متفاوتی دارند.

words.coreMeaning: تمایل شدید به خوردن یا مصرف
definitions: Having a very eager approach to an activity; wanting or devouring great quantities
Excessively eager or insatiable
examples: She is a voracious reader who finishes a book every two days.
The voracious appetite of the growing teenager surprised everyone.
words.trap: voracious reader بسیار رایج است. از لاتین vorare (بلعیدن) آمده.

words.coreMeaning: فردی با تعصب شدید نسبت به عقیده‌اش
definitions: A person who is fanatical and uncompromising in pursuit of their ideals
One who is excessively devoted to a cause
examples: The religious zealot refused to listen to any other viewpoint.
Political zealots on both sides blocked any compromise.
words.trap: zealot بار منفی دارد (متعصب) اما zeal (غیرت) می‌تواند مثبت باشد.

words.coreMeaning: خوش‌بینی و اعتماد به آینده
definitions: Optimistic or positive, especially in a difficult situation
Having the color of blood; ruddy
examples: She remained sanguine about the project's success.
He was sanguine that the negotiations would succeed.
words.trap: sanguine از لاتین sanguis (خون) آمده و ابتدا به معنای سرخ‌رو بودن بود.

words.coreMeaning: داشتن دقت و وجدان کامل در انجام کار
definitions: Very careful and thorough; having moral integrity
Extremely attentive to detail; conscientious
examples: She was scrupulous about following the rules.
The scrupulous researcher checked every fact twice.
words.trap: scrupulous و unscrupulous متضاد هستند. unscrupulous بسیار منفی‌تر است.

words.coreMeaning: صحبت کردن با خود بدون شنونده
definitions: An act of speaking one's thoughts aloud when alone
A dramatic speech in which a character reveals their thoughts to the audience
examples: Hamlet's famous soliloquy begins with 'To be or not to be'.
She delivered the soliloquy with great emotion.
words.trap: soliloquy و monologue متفاوت‌اند. soliloquy فقط با خود و monologue می‌تواند با شنونده باشد.

words.coreMeaning: استدلال ظاهر درست اما باطن غلط
definitions: The use of clever but false arguments, especially with the intention of deceiving
A method of argument that is seemingly plausible though actually invalid
examples: His argument was nothing but sophistry.
The lawyer's sophistry fooled the jury.
words.trap: sophistry بار منفی دارد و به معنای استدلال فریبنده است.

words.coreMeaning: صدای بلند و ناهنجار یا لحن تند
definitions: Loud and harsh; grating
Presenting a point of view in an excessively forceful way
examples: The strident noise of the alarm woke everyone up.
Her strident criticism of the government was relentless.
words.trap: strident هم به صدا و هم به لحن اطلاق می‌شود. بار منفی خفیفی دارد.

words.coreMeaning: ترفند و حیله برای پنهان کردن هدف واقعی
definitions: A trick or expedient used to evade a rule, escape a consequence, or conceal something
Deceit used in order to achieve one's goal
examples: The spy used subterfuge to gain access to the building.
Their subterfuge was eventually discovered.
words.trap: subterfuge از لاتین subter (زیر) + fugere (فرار کردن) آمده.

words.coreMeaning: نگاه از بالا به دیگران
definitions: Behaving or looking as though one thinks one is superior to others
Arrogantly superior; haughty
examples: The supercilious waiter made us feel unwelcome.
His supercilious attitude alienated his colleagues.
words.trap: supercilious از لاتین supercilium (ابرو) آمده - بالا نگاه کردن با ابروی بالا.

words.coreMeaning: عادت به سکوت و کم‌حرفی
definitions: Reserved or uncommunicative in speech; saying little
Temperamentally disinclined to talk
examples: The taciturn old man rarely spoke to anyone.
He became more taciturn after the tragedy.
words.trap: taciturn با tacit (ضمنی) متفاوت است. taciturn درباره شخص و tacit درباره توافق.

words.coreMeaning: مرتبط نبودن مستقیم با موضوع
definitions: Only superficially relevant; divergent
Relating to or along a tangent
examples: His comments were tangential to the main topic.
The discussion went off on tangential issues.
words.trap: tangential از tangent (مماس) آمده و به معنای حاشیه‌ای و غیرمرتبط مستقیم است.

words.coreMeaning: برابر بودن با چیزی از نظر اثر یا اهمیت
definitions: Equivalent in seriousness or effect; virtually the same as
Equal in value or significance
examples: His refusal was tantamount to a rejection.
Not voting is tantamount to supporting the status quo.
words.trap: tantamount همیشه با to می‌آید: tantamount to something.

words.coreMeaning: آماده انجام کار غیراخلاقی برای پول
definitions: Showing or motivated by susceptibility to bribery
Corrupt; mercenary
examples: The venal officials accepted bribes from the mob.
His venal nature was exposed during the investigation.
words.trap: venal با venial (قابل بخشش) اشتباه نگیرید! تلفظ مشابه اما معنای متفاوت.

words.coreMeaning: همیشه حقیقت گفتن
definitions: Speaking or representing the truth; truthful
Habitually truthful; honest
examples: The veracious witness was trusted by the jury.
A veracious account of the events was finally published.
words.trap: veracious و voracious (حریص) تلفظ مشابه دارند اما معنای متفاوت!

words.coreMeaning: تجربه کردن از طریق دیگران
definitions: Experienced through someone else rather than directly
Acting or done on behalf of another
examples: She got vicarious pleasure from watching her children play.
He lived vicariously through his adventurous friends.
words.trap: vicarious pleasure یعنی لذت از طریق تجربه دیگران. این اصطلاح بسیار رایج است.

words.coreMeaning: حمله شدید لفظی و ناسزاگویی
definitions: To blame or insult someone in strong or violent language
To abuse or censure severely
examples: The critics vituperated the author for his controversial book.
She vituperated her opponent during the debate.
words.trap: vituperate شدیدتر از criticize است و شامل ناسزاگویی می‌شود.

words.coreMeaning: عمدی و بی‌دلیل آسیب رساندن
definitions: Deliberate and unprovoked; gratuitous
Having no serious purpose; irresponsible
examples: The wanton destruction of the forest outraged environmentalists.
It was a wanton act of cruelty.
words.trap: wanton destruction (تخریب بی‌دلیل) بسیار رایج است و بار منفی شدیدی دارد.

words.coreMeaning: مربوط به مهمان‌نوازی
definitions: Of or relating to hospitality; relating to the relationship between host and guest
Friendly to strangers; hospitable
examples: The xenial culture of the region welcomed all visitors.
Their xenial traditions made guests feel at home.
words.trap: xenial از یونانی xenos (غریبه) آمده و با xenophobia (ترس از غریبه) هم‌ریشه است.

words.coreMeaning: فردی که با فداکاری خدمت می‌کند
definitions: A person who performs diligent and reliable service
A farmer who owns and cultivates a small farm
examples: She did yeoman's work in organizing the event.
The yeoman's efforts saved the project from failure.
words.trap: yeoman's work یعنی کار سخت و فداکارانه. این اصطلاح بسیار رایج است.

words.coreMeaning: پایین آوردن شأن و مقام
definitions: To lower in rank, dignity, or esteem
To humble or degrade
examples: He refused to abase himself before the tyrant.
The dictator sought to abase anyone who opposed him.
words.trap: با abash (شرمنده کردن) اشتباه نگیرید

words.coreMeaning: توافق و هماهنگی
definitions: An official agreement or treaty
To grant recognition or status
examples: The two nations signed a peace accord.
The committee accorded her the respect she deserved.
words.trap: of one's own accord یعنی خودبه‌خود

words.coreMeaning: افزایش قدرت فراتر از حد واقعی
definitions: To increase power, status, or wealth
To make something appear greater than it is
examples: The CEO aggrandized his role in the success.
She aggrandized her achievements on her resume.
words.trap: اغلب به صورت self-aggrandize استفاده می‌شود

words.coreMeaning: انحراف از هنجار معمول
definitions: Something that deviates from what is standard
An irregularity or deviation
examples: The warm weather in winter was an anomaly.
The test results showed a strange anomaly.
words.trap: جمع: anomalies

words.coreMeaning: exact opposite or direct contrast
definitions: A person or thing that is the direct opposite
A contrast or opposition
examples: His calm was the antithesis of panic.
The luxury hotel was the antithesis of the hostel.
words.trap: جمع: antitheses

words.coreMeaning: نداشتن علاقه یا نگرانی
definitions: Lack of interest, enthusiasm, or concern
A state of indifference
examples: Voter apathy led to low turnout.
His apathy toward studies worried his parents.
words.trap: a (بدون) + pathos (احساس)

words.coreMeaning: ساده و صادق بدون حیله
definitions: Without guile or deception; natural
Lacking art or skill; crude
examples: Her artless smile revealed genuine kindness.
The child's artless honesty charmed everyone.
words.trap: معنای منفی ندارد

words.coreMeaning: کاهش شدت یا قدرت
definitions: To reduce force, effect, or value
To make thin; to weaken
examples: The noise was attenuated by the walls.
Years of hardship attenuated his resolve.
words.trap: در فیزیک به معنای کاهش سیگنال هم هست

words.coreMeaning: انتقاد شدید و رسمی
definitions: To express severe disapproval formally
The expression of formal disapproval
examples: The senator was censured for unethical behavior.
The report was a censure of the practices.
words.trap: با censor (سانسورچی) اشتباه نگیرید

words.coreMeaning: استفاده از ترفندهای فریبکارانه
definitions: The use of trickery to achieve a purpose
Deception by artful subterfuge
examples: The lawyer's chicanery was exposed.
Political chicanery undermined democracy.
words.trap: ریشه فرانسوی chicane

words.coreMeaning: فهمیدن معنای چیزی
definitions: To interpret or understand the meaning
To analyze grammatical structure
examples: His silence was construed as guilt.
The law can be construed in several ways.
words.trap: با construct (ساختن) اشتباه نگیرید

words.coreMeaning: آشنایی با فرهنگ‌های مختلف
definitions: Familiar with many cultures
Including people from many countries
examples: New York is a cosmopolitan city.

words.coreMeaning: مخلوطی نامتجانس و بی‌نظم از چیزهای مختلف
definitions: A confused jumble or medley of things
A hodgepodge; a miscellaneous collection of disparate elements
examples: The flea market was a gallimaufry of antiques, junk, and curiosities.
His bookshelf displayed a gallimaufry of genres and topics.
words.trap: اصطلاحی قدیمی فرانسوی که اصل آن به نوعی خوراک مخلوط اشاره دارد.

words.coreMeaning: سخنرانی یا نصیحتی طولانی و خسته‌کننده درباره اخلاق
definitions: A sermon or speech intended to provide moral instruction, often tedious
A tedious moralizing lecture or piece of writing
examples: The principal delivered a lengthy homily on the importance of honesty.
We had to sit through another homily about proper workplace behavior.
words.trap: با 'homily' (هم‌آوایی) در زبان‌شناسی اشتباه گرفته نشود. homily به معنای موعظه است.

words.coreMeaning: بی‌محتوا، سطحی و فاقد عمق یا جالبیت
definitions: Naive, simplistic, and superficial
Dull, lacking nourishment or substance; barren
examples: The professor dismissed the student's jejune arguments.
His jejune writing style failed to engage sophisticated readers.
words.trap: ریشه لاتین آن به معنای 'ناشتا' است (از jejunum، روده باریک). اما در استفاده رایج به معنای سطحی و بی‌مایه.

words.coreMeaning: احساس خستگی شدید جسمی یا ذهنی
definitions: A state of physical or mental weariness; lack of energy
Listlessness or lethargy resulting from fatigue or ennui
examples: A deep lassitude overcame her after the long journey.
The lassitude of the hot summer afternoon made work impossible.
words.trap: با 'latitude' (عرض جغرافیایی) اشتباه گرفته نشود. lassitude به معنای خستگی و سستی است.

words.coreMeaning: پایین‌ترین نقطه؛ بدترین لحظه
definitions: The lowest point in the fortunes of a person or organization
The point on the celestial sphere directly opposite the zenith; rock bottom
examples: The company reached its nadir when it filed for bankruptcy.
Morale was at its nadir after months of failed negotiations.
words.trap: اصطلاح نجومی. نقطه مقابل 'zenith' است. در فارسی 'حضیض' ترجمه دقیق آن است.

words.coreMeaning: پاسخ سریع و تیز، معمولاً در بحث یا شمشیربازی
definitions: A quick, clever reply to an insult or criticism
In fencing, a quick return thrust after a parry
examples: Her witty riposte silenced the heckler.
He was known for his sharp ripostes during debates.
words.trap: اصطلاح شمشیربازی است. با 'repost' (بازنشر) اشتباه گرفته نشود.

words.coreMeaning: حالت بی‌حرکتی و بی‌حالی شدید
definitions: A state of physical or mental inactivity; lethargy
A state of dormancy or hibernation characterized by reduced metabolic activity
examples: The summer heat induced a torpor that made it hard to think.
The bear entered a state of torpor during the winter months.
words.trap: با 'temper' (خلق) اشتباه گرفته نشود. torpor به معنای بی‌حالی کامل است.

words.coreMeaning: شبح یا تصویر روح‌مانند کسی که قرار است بمیرد
definitions: A ghostly image or specter of a person, especially one seen shortly before or after death
A pale, thin, or insubstantial person or thing
examples: She looked like a wraith after her long illness.
A wraith-like figure appeared in the fog at the edge of the forest.
words.trap: با 'wrath' (خشم) اشتباه گرفته نشود! تلفظ و املای متفاوتی دارند.

words.coreMeaning: پیچیده و رازآلود؛ دشوار برای درک
definitions: Difficult to interpret or understand; mysterious and puzzling
Resembling an enigma; obscure and inscrutable
examples: The Mona Lisa's enigmatic smile has fascinated people for centuries.
He remained enigmatic about his plans for the future.
words.trap: با 'erratic' (غیرقابل‌پیش‌بینی) اشتباه گرفته نشود. enigmatic به معنای رازآلود است.

words.coreMeaning: تازه شکل‌گرفته و هنوز کامل نشده
definitions: Just begun and so not fully formed or developed; rudimentary
Imperfectly formed or developed; in an early stage
examples: The inchoate plan still needed considerable development.
Her inchoate ideas gradually took shape over several months.
words.trap: با 'incoherent' (نامنسجم) اشتباه گرفته نشود. inchoate به معنای ابتدایی و ناقص است.

words.coreMeaning: تظاهر به بیماری برای فرار از وظیفه
definitions: To pretend to be ill in order to escape duty or work
To feign illness or incapacity to avoid responsibility
examples: The soldier was caught malingering to avoid deployment.
Some employees malinger to get extra days off.
words.trap: با 'malign' (بدگویی) اشتباه گرفته نشود. malinger به معنای تظاهر به بیماری.

words.coreMeaning: بدخلق و زودرنج به شکل کودکانه
definitions: Childishly sulky or bad-tempered
Irritable and peevish; marked by impatience
examples: The petulant child threw a tantrum when he didn't get his way.
His petulant behavior embarrassed his family at the restaurant.
words.trap: با 'perpetual' (ابدی) اشتباه گرفته نشود. petulant به معنای بدخلق.

words.coreMeaning: a damaging or derogatory remark; slander
definitions: An attack on the reputation or integrity of someone
A damaging or derogatory remark; slander or calumny
examples: He cast aspersions on his opponent's character.
She resented the aspersions cast upon her professional integrity.
words.trap: همیشه با 'cast' استفاده می‌شود: 'cast aspersions on'.

words.coreMeaning: رها کردن یا دور انداختن چیزی که دیگر لازم نیست
definitions: To throw or drop something from an aircraft or ship
To abandon or discard something as undesirable or burdensome
examples: The company jettisoned its failing divisions to focus on core business.
She jettisoned her old habits and embraced a healthier lifestyle.
words.trap: اصطلاحاً به معنای رها کردن سریع و بدون ترحم چیزی ناخواسته است.

words.coreMeaning: احساس حسرت و آرام غم برای چیزی که در دسترس نیست
definitions: Having or showing a feeling of vague or regretful longing
Full of yearning or desire tinged with melancholy
examples: She cast a wistful glance at her childhood home as they drove away.
He felt wistful thinking about the opportunities he had missed.
words.trap: با 'wishful' (آرزومندانه) نزدیک است اما wistful بار غم‌آلودتری دارد.

words.coreMeaning: تدریجاً تخریب‌کننده؛ مضر برای اخلاق یا روابط
definitions: Having the ability to wear away or destroy gradually
Gradually harmful or destructive to feelings or institutions
examples: The corrosive effects of corruption undermined public trust.
Acid is highly corrosive and can damage metal surfaces.
words.trap: هم به معنای تحت‌اللفظی (شیمیایی) و هم مجازی (تخریب‌کننده) استفاده می‌شود.

words.coreMeaning: ابزار مخالفت یا اکراه مودبانه
definitions: To raise doubts or objections; to show reluctance
To object or take exception; to express disagreement politely
examples: She demurred at the suggestion of working overtime without pay.
When asked to sign, he demurred, citing legal concerns.
words.trap: با 'demure' (متین) اشتباه گرفته نشود! demur فعل است، demure صفت.

words.coreMeaning: تحریک و تشویق به شورش یا ناآرامی
definitions: To instigate or stir up an undesirable sentiment or action
To promote the growth of; to incite or encourage
examples: The agitators tried to foment rebellion among the workers.
His inflammatory speech fomented anger and division.
words.trap: با 'ferment' (تخمیر) اشتباه گرفته نشود. foment به معنای تحریک و دامن زدن است.

words.coreMeaning: رفتار اغراق‌آمیز و نمایشی برای جلب توجه
definitions: Overly theatrical or dramatic in character or style
Deliberately affected or exaggerated for emotional effect
examples: Her histrionic outburst embarrassed everyone at the dinner table.
He dismissed her complaints as histrionic theatrics.
words.trap: از 'histrio' (بازیگر در لاتین). با 'historic' (تاریخی) اشتباه گرفته نشود!

words.coreMeaning: رفتار دوگانه و فریبکارانه
definitions: Deceitfulness; double-dealing; the quality of being two-faced
Deliberate deceptiveness in behavior or speech
examples: His duplicity was revealed when both wives discovered each other.
The spy maintained an air of duplicity throughout the mission.
words.trap: از ریشه لاتین 'duplex' (دوگانه). با 'duplicate' (تکثیر) هم‌ریشه.

words.coreMeaning: مسافرت از مکانی به مکان دیگر برای کار
definitions: Traveling from place to place, especially for work
Wandering; not fixed in one location
examples: The itinerant workers moved from farm to farm during harvest season.
The itinerant preacher traveled across the country.
words.trap: از ریشه لاتین 'itineris' (سفر). با 'iterate' (تکرار) ارتباطی ندارد.

words.translation: کناره‌گیری کردن، تاج را واگذار کردن
words.coreMeaning: renouncing a throne or giving up authority and responsibility
definitions: To renounce or give up a throne, right, power, or responsibility formally
To abandon or relinquish a position or duty
examples: The king was forced to abdicate the throne after the revolution.
Parents should not abdicate their responsibility to discipline their children.
words.trap: بیشتر به معنای رسمی ترک تخت سلطنت استفاده می‌شود اما می‌تواند به هر مسئولیتی اطلاق شود.

words.coreMeaning: سزاوار سرزنش و نکوهش به خاطر رفتار نادرست
definitions: Deserving censure or condemnation; morally wrong
Deserving of blame and strong disapproval
examples: His reprehensible behavior during the scandal shocked the nation.
The company's reprehensible treatment of its workers led to protests.
words.trap: با 'representable' (قابل‌نمایش) اشتباه گرفته نشود. reprehensible بار منفی شدیدی دارد.

words.coreMeaning: تحریف یا تقلیل مضحک و توهین‌آمیز چیزی جدی
definitions: A false, absurd, or distorted representation of something
A grotesque imitation or parody that debases the original
examples: The trial was a travesty of justice from the very beginning.
His performance was a travesty of the original play.
words.trap: با 'tragedy' (تراژدی) اشتباه گرفته نشود! travesty تحریف مضحک است، tragedy رویداد غم‌انگیز.

words.coreMeaning: عادت به زیاد و طولانی صحبت کردن
definitions: The quality of being excessively talkative; loquacity
A tendency to chatter on at length about trivial matters
examples: Her garrulity at parties made her the center of attention.
The old man's garrulity was endearing to some but tiresome to others.
words.trap: اسم مرتبط با صفت 'garrulous' است. با 'garrulity' و 'garrulousness' تفاوتی ندارد.

words.coreMeaning: بسیار بد و نفرت‌انگیز؛ فراتر از حد تحمل
definitions: Utterly odious or wicked; shockingly evil
Hatefully or shockingly evil; grossly offensive to morality
examples: The heinous crime shocked the entire community.
Such heinous acts have no place in a civilized society.
words.trap: با 'hideous' (زشت) نزدیک است اما heinous شدیدتر و بیشتر مربوط به اخلاق و جنایت است.

words.coreMeaning: بسیار زیبا و درخشان؛ باشکوه
definitions: Attractive and impressive through being richly colorful or radiant
Shining brilliantly; gleaming with splendor
examples: The bride looked resplendent in her white gown.
The palace was resplendent with gold and precious gems.
words.trap: از ریشه لاتین 'resplendere' (بسیار درخشیدن). معمولاً با حرف اضافه 'in' استفاده می‌شود.

words.coreMeaning: بسیار پیچیده و گیج‌کننده مانند هزارتو
definitions: Complicated and difficult to follow or understand
Like a labyrinth; irregular and twisting
examples: The labyrinthine bureaucracy made simple tasks take months.
They got lost in the labyrinthine corridors of the old castle.
words.trap: از نام هزارتوی مینوتور در اساطیر یونانی آمده.

words.coreMeaning: صحبت کردن سریع، روان و بدون توقف
definitions: Speaking or spoken incessantly and fluently
Turning rapidly on an axis; fluent in speech
examples: The voluble salesperson talked for twenty minutes without pausing.
He became voluble on the subject of his favorite hobby.
words.trap: از ریشه لاتین 'volvere' (چرخاندن). با 'volume' (حجم) هم‌ریشه.

words.coreMeaning: دارای اثر مطلوب و موفق
definitions: Successful in producing a desired or intended result; effective
Having the power to produce a desired effect
examples: The new treatment proved highly efficacious in clinical trials.
She found meditation to be efficacious in reducing stress.
words.trap: با 'effective' (مؤثر) نزدیک است اما efficacious رسمی‌تر و بیشتر در پزشکی.

words.coreMeaning: نظریه یا فلسفه حقوق
definitions: The theory or philosophy of law
A body of court decisions interpreting a point of law
examples: Constitutional jurisprudence has evolved significantly over the decades.
She studied comparative jurisprudence at Oxford.
words.trap: از ریشه لاتین 'juris' (حقوق) و 'prudentia' (خرد). فقط به معنای فقه و نظریه حقوقی.

words.coreMeaning: supreme blessedness or happiness
definitions: A state of utmost bliss; supreme happiness
A declaration of blessedness, especially in the Sermon on the Mount
examples: She experienced a sense of beatitude after the meditation retreat.
The beatitudes are central to Christian teachings.
words.trap: از ریشه لاتین 'beatus' (خوشبخت). با 'attitude' (نگرش) اشتباه گرفته نشود.

words.coreMeaning: the rise and fall of the voice in speech; rhythmic flow
definitions: A modulation or inflection of the voice; rhythmic flow
The regular beat or rhythm of speech, music, or movement
examples: The poet's cadence gave the words a musical quality.
The cadence of the marching soldiers echoed through the streets.
words.trap: از ریشه لاتین 'cadere' (falling). در موسیقی به معنای توالی نت‌های پایانی.

words.coreMeaning: the concluding passage of a piece of music or a statement
definitions: The concluding passage of a piece of music or movement
A concluding event, remark, or section; an epilogue
examples: The symphony's magnificent coda brought the audience to their feet.
The book's coda tied together all the loose ends of the story.
words.trap: از ریشه ایتالیانی 'coda' (دم). با 'code' (کد) اشتباه گرفته نشود.

words.coreMeaning: greed for money or possessions
definitions: Greed for money or possessions; avarice
An excessive desire to have more than one's fair share
examples: His cupidity was the driving force behind every business decision.
The cupidity of the colonial powers devastated the local economy.
words.trap: از نام 'کیوپید' (خدای عشق) نیست! از ریشه لاتین 'cupido' (آرزو/طمع).

words.coreMeaning: producing an abundance of offspring or new growth; highly fertile
definitions: Producing many offspring or new growth; very fertile
Intellectually productive; inventive and creative
examples: The fecund soil of the valley supported abundant agriculture.
Her fecund imagination produced a new novel every year.
words.trap: با 'feckless' (بی‌عرضه) اشتباه گرفته نشود. fecund مثبت و به معنای بارور.

words.coreMeaning: to deny or contradict; to speak against
definitions: To deny or contradict; to speak against
To oppose or challenge; to dispute the truth of
examples: No one could gainsay the evidence presented in court.
She was a formidable debater that no one could gainsay.
words.trap: از 'gain' (سود) + 'say' (گفتن). اما به معنای 'برخلاف گفتن' است.
